title: PSD to AI
about: PSD to AI is a focused BROBEX Image Studio tool for image format conversion. Convert VND.ADOBE.PHOTOSHOP files to APPLICATION/POSTSCRIPT where supported by this browser. It is intended for people who need a practical way to prepare, inspect, or transform digital content without navigating an unrelated editor. The exact result depends on the source file, the controls exposed by this page, and the processing method used by the current implementation. Review the workspace before selecting a file so the input and expected output are clear.
steps: Read the accepted file types and upload limits displayed in the workspace before starting.
Select a source file using the file picker or drag-and-drop area when supported. Confirm the preview matches the file you intended to edit.
Review the controls provided by this exact tool. Adjust only the settings that are available; other BROBEX tools may have different controls.

Start the operation and wait for the actual processing result. Browser-based operations depend on device memory and supported browser APIs; integration-dependent operations require their configured service.
Inspect the output preview and check edges, colors, transparency, dimensions, or layout as relevant to this operation. Download the result when the workspace provides a working download action.
capabilities: The registered processing method for this tool is Specialist codec / vectorization integration. The tool accepts the formats listed in the workspace. Its intended task is convert vnd.adobe.photoshop files to application/postscript where supported by this browser. Only controls and output choices visible in the current workspace should be treated as supported. The tool does not silently add unrelated editing features, and an operation that needs a provider cannot be considered available until that integration is configured and tested.
benefits: This workflow can make a repetitive image format conversion task more approachable by keeping the relevant action in one place. It may be useful when preparing images for websites, forms, documents, presentations, archives, or everyday sharing, depending on the selected operation. Working from a copy is recommended whenever the original file is important. A quick review of the output helps catch quality changes, unsupported content, or formatting differences before the file is used elsewhere.
limitations: Supported input types are the formats listed in the workspace. Browser processing can be affected by device memory, browser version, image dimensions, and file complexity. The required processing integration is not configured as a verified working service in this project; the page must not imply that processing has completed. Conversion and compression can change quality, metadata, transparency, color handling, or layout. Always verify the exported file in its intended destination.
